text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can paint pictures, compose music, and even write stories. Some people are amazed by these creations, while others worry that machines might replace human artists. However, the difference is important. A human artist draws on personal emotions, life experiences, and culture. AI, on the other hand, learns from large amounts of data and imitates patterns. It can copy styles, but it does not truly feel joy or sadness. In the end, AI is a useful tool. It can inspire us and save time, but real creativity—with its surprises and deep meaning—remains uniquely human.
